c152767265.notes: Green highway name board, Jawi above Rumi. The Jawi is written as two words (ه in final form, not joined to ر) though the Latin is one word 'Lebuhraya'. Angled view with glare at right.

c157060582.notes: Village name sign (Bandar Seri Begawan). Peeling paint; a scratch above the second A of KIULAP can look like an accent but is damage.

c179973749.notes: Seria. Frontal green street-name sign, Jawi above Rumi.

c180536798.notes: Kampong Lugu. Small green street-name sign. The Jawi 'g' is drawn as a plain kaf (no dot visible, so transcribed ك rather than the standard Jawi ڬ).

c182288743.notes: Kuala Belait. Frontal green street-name sign; 'KA 1131' is a red reference tag on the sign itself (not a vehicle plate). Distractors: 'POLIS' box below, partial 'GEMAKING' banner behind.

c180896330.notes: Kuala Belait. Green street-name sign, slightly angled. The red 'KA 1131' tag is the same code as on the Jalan Pretty sign (c182288743), so it is a sign-maintenance tag, not part of the name.

c158083873.notes: Kampong Kiarong. Shot through a car windscreen. Target is the central 'Pepper Lunch' fascia with logo; the Jawi name is on the separate fascia at left in calligraphic style, and a third 'Pepper Lunch' sign is on the lower canopy. Distractors at right: 'poppy petals SKIN & BEAUTY' with Jawi, 'crystalens / SYARIKAT CRYSTALENS / CRYSTALENS COMPANY' with Jawi 'شريكة كريستلين س'. Parked cars incidental.

c158516313.reason: brand advertising panels over an electronics store (Skyworth, Airbot, dyson, HONOR, Canon, with Jawi); the shop's own name is cut off at the top

c164206557.notes: Sungai Tujoh, near the Malaysian border. Large green distance board, Latin only, shot from a car at a slight angle.

c154067290.notes: White mukim/village name board, frontal; the left edge of the panel is bent. Jawi above Rumi for each name.

c16167272.reason: wrong country: tourist sign in Nanjing, China (Brunei Heritage Village / Tomb of the King of Brunei)

c16167242.reason: wrong country: tourist direction signs in Nanjing, China

c16178541.reason: wrong country: path signs at the Tomb of the King of Boni, Nanjing, China

c163116281.reason: no-smoking/vaping penalty notice (Ministry of Health); warning, no place name

c120306806.notes: White Jawi/Malay village-boundary board on black-and-white striped posts, Jalan Singa Menteri, Mumong. Upper half names the mukim, lower half the kampung; 'B' is in curly single quotes in both scripts.
